response.description:
Azure Event Grid Standard Namespace now supports MQTT v5 subscription identifier capabilities in GA. Now each MQTT subscription can include an identifier that is
delivered with incoming messages, enabling applications to route events
immediately based on subscription context rather than parsing topic strings.
This results in cleaner application logic and faster message handling for
scenarios such as dashboards, alerts, and analytics pipelines.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure Event Grid - MQTT v5 Subscription Identifier
